line.en: outdoor flea market, open 08:00 to 16:00 on saturdays and sundays, free to walk in. fruit and vegetables, new and used clothes, furniture, tools and home goods; vendors come and go.
line.de: freiluft-flohmarkt, samstags und sonntags von 08:00 bis 16:00, der eintritt ist frei. obst und gemüse, neue und gebrauchte kleidung, möbel, werkzeug und haushaltswaren; die stände wechseln.
line.tr: açık hava pazarı, cumartesi ve pazar 08:00 - 16:00 arası, girişi ücretsiz. meyve sebze, yeni ve kullanılmış giysi, mobilya, alet ve ev eşyası; tezgâhlar değişebilir.

sparks.why: Plaza Mariachi flea, recurring every Saturday and Sunday 8 AM to 4 PM at 3955 Nolensville Pike, per the plazamariachi.com November 2026 calendar and its weekend description; no individual 2026 dates were listed, so the weekend pattern is the source.
